Sam (sales): Heads up — Belfort Analytics wants a 12mo Dedicated commit POC concession. Asking for 40% off list for the first 6 months, then 25% thereafter. Need deal desk approval and margin check.
Diego (revops): What's the committed GPUs / monthly tokens? Also need ARR and ACV. cc @Priya (finance)
Sam (sales): 4x A100-equivalent lanes, est $18k/mo list, so ~ $10.8k/mo at 40% -> $64.8k over 6mo. They're asking for Dedicated + Private deploy options and strict data residency.
Priya (finance): 40% is below our pricing floor for Dedicated pilots. Floor for pilot Dedicated is 30% unless VP signoff. Need gross margin calc and expected lifetime value.
Riley (solutions): For POC they're running ~2M tokens/day, very spiky. Suggest 30% + usage overage (meter after threshold). Also recommend reserving 75% of expected peak to avoid noisy neighbor issues.
Maya (legal): We'll need a security addendum, confirm SOC2 scope, and KMS/HSM details for private deploy. Procurement will insist on a SOW. Can you share Belfort's legal contact?
Sam (sales): Legal contact is kate@belfort.com. I'll push for 35% as a compromise. Any quick path to VP approval if they push for 40%?
Priya (finance): If you can justify strategic reference value and >$150k ARR projected, finance can greenlight 35% with sales ops signoff. Otherwise escalate to VP Revenue. Include churn and logo value in justification.
Diego (revops): For the dealdesk request include this calc snippet so pricing ops can reproduce: 
```
list = 18000
discount = 0.35
price = list*(1-discount)
```
Sam (sales): OK will update ACV assumptions and open dealdesk ticket. @Maya please prep short SOW template and security checklist. @dealbot can you create exception ticket? :pray:
dealbot: Ticket #DD-2025 opened for Belfort special pricing. Owner: Priya (finance). Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-2025
Maya (legal): Drafting SOW now, will target sharing by EOD. Also need to confirm whether Belfort requires subprocessor list. :clock1:
Priya (finance): Added constraint — for pilot discounts we require a minimum 6mo prepaid billing term. Also need to lock renewal pricing floor.
Sam (sales): Thanks — I'll push Belfort on the 6mo prepay and try to land 35%. Will post final numbers and attach Belfort's internal risk assessment when I have it.
